target: Siroino _Large through the official SiroinoSotai_PC shape keys; body measurements and fit remain unverified

requiredPatternComponents.reason: The hoodless cape must cover front and back shoulders while preserving open arm slits; all three shell panels and shoulder joins must be explicit.
The deep-teal sleeveless tunic is a separate fitted layer and must remain connected through its shoulder and side seams.
The knee-length cream wrap skirt is a separate layer; its shell panels need connected side seams before any avatar fit work.

researchTrial.method: explicit polygon panels with one-to-one boundary stitches submitted to pinned GarmentCode/PyGarment 2D preview
researchTrial.physicalSewingStitch: Cape left/right shoulder joins, tunic shoulders and side seams, skirt left/right side seams. Cape center-front snaps and skirt wrap overlap are closures, not inferred sewing seams.; high stand collar base joined to the left-front, back, and right-front neckline edges; back storm flap top edge shares the center-back neckline seam with the collar, with a free lower hem; asymmetric wrap-overlap top edge joined to the front skirt waist as a provisional layered seam; left and right snap-placket strips attach to the corresponding cape center-front boundaries; rust hip pouch front and back are joined at both sides and the lower edge, and the pouch back mounts to one waist-belt edge segment; pouch front and back connect through left, right, and bottom gussets with both lower corners closed, while a separate flap hinges at the pouch front top edge; seven cape edge-binding strips attach along the three hem and four arm-opening boundaries, with the finished edge represented as a free hem edge; an 80 mm provisional fabric buckle-return tab joins the belt left-end; each of two sliding keeper loops closes through one equal 10 mm edge seam
researchTrial.review: Review source front/back views and the generated GarmentCode panel layout. GarmentCode 2D output alone is not assembled-shape or fit evidence. The collar strip is a provisional 65 mm-high pattern hypothesis; review it directly and do not treat the flat preview as assembled-shape or fit evidence. The back storm flap is a provisional trapezoid extending 55 mm from the shared center-back neckline seam; appearance and drape remain unverified. The front wrap-overlap panel is a provisional 430 mm-long asymmetric overlay; its diagonal edge, closure, and placement remain unverified. The placket strips are provisional 18 mm-wide, 240 mm-long pieces; the three visible snap closure positions remain unmeasured hypotheses. The waist strap is a provisional 650 x 35 mm estimate derived from the configured avatar's 550 mm body section at a reference-estimated 67% stature belt line, plus 20 mm garment/ease allowance and the declared 80 mm buckle-return tab. Belt height, allowance, overlap and fit still require review. The pouch remains a provisional 120 x 160 mm flat-pattern hypothesis; pouch depth, buckle, and pouch flap remain unverified. Gusset depth is a provisional 25 mm and flap drop is 50 mm; pouch location, snap position, volume, and closure action are unverified. The seven cape binding-strip widths are provisional 16 mm flat widths; exact finished width, fold method, strip-end treatment, and cloth/material behavior are unverified. The buckle-return tab is provisionally 80 mm long and attaches along the belt 35 mm end edge; each keeper strip is provisionally 45 mm in circumference by 10 mm wide. Keeper placement and avatar clearance, buckle-tab fold path, actual buckle dimensions, material, and fastening behavior remain unverified. The metal frame and center prong remain separate hardware geometry and are not represented as fabric seams.

releaseBoundary: Keep WORKING and visualAppearanceReview PENDING until a candidate shows the complete cape, sleeveless tunic, and wrap skirt from required direct views; do not initialize 3D before that gate passes.
